verses.hasbuna-l-lahu-wani-ma-l-wakilu-c1-v1: ḥasbunā llāhu lī waniʿma l-wakīlu lā ʾilā ghayrihi ladayyā sabīlu
verses.hasbuna-l-lahu-wani-ma-l-wakilu-c1-v2: sallimi l-ʾamri kulla ʾamri ʾilayhi fī jamīʿi l-ʾaḥwāli wahuwa kafīlu
verses.hasbuna-l-lahu-wani-ma-l-wakilu-c1-v3: bāraka llāhu fī l-ḥayāti wafīmā baʿdahā jalla wāḥidā lā yazūlu
verses.hasbuna-l-lahu-wani-ma-l-wakilu-c1-v4: niʿma ʿabdu llāhi ʾakhlaṣa dīnā kāna llāhi kulluhu maqbūlu
verses.hasbuna-l-lahu-wani-ma-l-wakilu-c1-v5: ʾasʿadu n-nāsi muṭlaqā man ʾilayhi sallama l-ʾamra lā lighayri yamīlu
verses.hasbuna-l-lahu-wani-ma-l-wakilu-c1-v6: ʾamalī ʾan ʾakūna llāhi ʿabdā mukhliṣā lā siwāhu lī maʾamūlu
verses.hasbuna-l-lahu-wani-ma-l-wakilu-c1-v7: laysa lī fī d-dunā wifī d-dāri l-ʾukhrī maṭmaʿu ghayra ʾannanī mawṣūlu
verses.hasbuna-l-lahu-wani-ma-l-wakilu-c1-v8: liraḍā llāhu lā sawāhu marāmiyī fī ḥuḍūrī waghaybatī ʾidh ʾajūlu
verses.hasbuna-l-lahu-wani-ma-l-wakilu-c1-v9: hawa lī l-maṭlabu l-waḥīdu l-murajjā maʿa mā bihi man ghaflahi lā taḥūlu
verses.hasbuna-l-lahu-wani-ma-l-wakilu-c1-v10: wahwa rabbī wakullu ḥālī ḥasbī naʿam ḥasbā ḥasbī waniʿma l-wakīlu
verses.hasbuna-l-lahu-wani-ma-l-wakilu-c1-v11: nasʾalu llāha - war-rajāʾu minhu faḍlā - ʾan yarānā waḥablunā maftūlu
verses.hasbuna-l-lahu-wani-ma-l-wakilu-c1-v12: ʿalla rabbī - walam yazal bī khifiyyā - yaqbalu t-tawba tawbatī l-masʾūlu
verses.hasbuna-l-lahu-wani-ma-l-wakilu-c1-v13: murtajī l-faḍli faḍlihi kalla ḥāli lam yakhib kallu suʾulihi maḥṣūlu
verses.hasbuna-l-lahu-wani-ma-l-wakilu-c1-v14: ʾakrama l-ʾakrimīna ʾarḥama min yar ḥamu ʿabdā ʾaʿlā munāhu l-wuṣūlu
verses.hasbuna-l-lahu-wani-ma-l-wakilu-c1-v15: laysa fīmā maḍā walā mā sayaʾatā raghbuhu lī siwāhu niʿma s-sabīlu
verses.hasbuna-l-lahu-wani-ma-l-wakilu-c1-v16: wahwa lī munyatī waghāyata saʾulī ʿaqdu ʿahdī lighayrihi maḥlūlu
verses.hasbuna-l-lahu-wani-ma-l-wakilu-c1-v17: kullu kullī llāhi ʿabdu walakin sitruhu lil-ʿuyūbi minnī jamīlu
verses.hasbuna-l-lahu-wani-ma-l-wakilu-c1-v18: yā ʾilahī ʾarjā laʿabdi dhalīli ʿafwuka l-jamma war-riḍā mabdhūlu
verses.hasbuna-l-lahu-wani-ma-l-wakilu-c1-v19: laka mannī qalbu yasīru ʾasīrā lladhī kāna yartaḍīhi rasūlu
verses.hasbuna-l-lahu-wani-ma-l-wakilu-c1-v20: ṣalli rabbī ʿalayhi maʿ kulli ʾāli waṣaḥābi waman lahu tamthīlu
